resources.string: PD2 Launcher Lite plays your own Diablo II with Project Diablo 2. Copy the folder from your PC to this device, then pick it here. The app copies it into its own storage; the folder you pick does not change.
The folder needs Diablo II with Lord of Destruction and Project Diablo 2 installed (the ProjectD2 folder with its launcher). The official PD2 launcher keeps it up to date afterwards.
This is not a Diablo II folder (it has no Game.exe). Pick the folder Diablo II is installed in.
This Diablo II folder has no Project Diablo 2 (no ProjectD2 folder). Install Project Diablo 2 into it first (on a PC, with PD2\'s installer), then import it.
Project Diablo 2 is not complete in this folder (no ProjectDiablo.dll in ProjectD2). Repair it with PD2\'s launcher on a PC, then import it.
The official PD2 launcher is not in this folder (no PD2Launcher.exe in ProjectD2). Install it with PD2\'s installer on a PC, then import the folder.
Not enough space: this needs %1$,d MB, %2$,d MB are free.
Not now: an import runs, or the game is open. Try again once it is done.
Not now: an import runs, or the game is open. Try again once it is done.
The app copies your folder into its own storage, then checks Project Diablo 2 in the copy. The folder you picked does not change.
The folder you picked did not change. Try again copies it from the start.
Diablo II with Project Diablo 2 is in the app now. Next: Start launcher opens the official PD2 launcher; its Play starts the game.
Game.exe, Project Diablo 2 and its launcher found
The copy is not complete: %1$s is missing.
Some of the characters Start over kept could not go back into the game (%1$s). They are safe in the app\'s storage; the next import puts them back.
The official PD2 launcher didn\'t open. Try again, or check the game in Repair.
The official PD2 launcher stopped responding and was closed. Start launcher opens it again.
Check again looks over your game folder and the game support files. Start over removes the app\'s copy of your Diablo II folder so that you can import it again; your characters are kept.
Missing: %1$s. Start over and import the folder again.
Missing: ProjectD2/PD2Launcher.exe. Start over and import a folder that has it.

Start over removes the app\'s copy of your Diablo II folder: the game files, Project Diablo 2 and their settings. Your characters are kept: they move to the app\'s own storage and go back into the next folder you import (beside its own characters, in Save/Kept, when the names are the same). The folder on your device does not change.
Start over can\'t run now: the game or an import is still running. Try again once it has closed.
Start over didn\'t remove anything: your characters couldn\'t be moved first (%1$s). Try again.
